meta.title: ROSE Technology | ROSE S.A.S.
meta.description: ROSE S.A.S. — Business Systems Repair and Optimization Center. End-to-end technology solutions, Myshop, repair services and products for companies and SMEs in Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia.

hero.lede: End-to-end technology solutions for companies and SMEs in Villavicencio, Meta. More than five years of experience, highly trained staff and an unwavering commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

about.title: Technology as a strategic ally — not a problem.
about.lede: ROSE S.A.S. is a Colombian technology provider based in Villavicencio, Meta. We specialize in repair, optimization and systems implementation, and in software development for companies, SMEs and individuals. We handle urgent repairs, scheduled preventive maintenance, administrative systems and security cameras.
about.mission: To deliver comprehensive technology solutions in repair, maintenance and software development to companies and SMEs in Villavicencio and Meta, with highly trained staff, ensuring quality, trust and optimized business systems for our clients.
about.vision: To be the leading technology services and digital solutions company in the Meta region, recognized for technical excellence, continuous innovation and a commitment to our clients’ business growth.

values.title: Experience
values.text: More than five years in the regional technology sector, with hundreds of successful projects.

values.title: Certified staff
values.text: Technicians and developers in continuous training to deliver the best solutions available.

values.title: Business focus
values.text: Solutions designed specifically for the real needs of SMEs and companies in the region.

values.title: Regional coverage
values.text: Specialized service in Villavicencio and the metropolitan area of the Meta department.

services.title: Technical service is the heart of ROSE S.A.S.
services.lede: When equipment fails, your business loses productivity, time and money. That is why we offer fast, reliable, warrantied repair and maintenance across the electronic devices essential to any modern operation.
services.lede2: From first contact we run an initial diagnosis protocol, a transparent quote, quality-parts repair and thorough testing before handover. Every unit leaving our workshop goes through rigorous quality control. We work with all brands and models, from simple faults to complex hardware and software issues, with preventive and corrective plans year-round.

devices.alt: Desktop motherboard with CPU socket and memory slots on the workbench
devices.title: Computers and towers
devices.text: Hardware repair, operating-system optimization, internal cleaning, component replacement and preventive maintenance for desktops and custom towers.

devices.alt: Hands installing an SSD inside an open laptop
devices.title: Laptops
devices.text: Diagnosis and repair of screens, keyboards, batteries, charging ports, overheating and software faults across all brands.

devices.alt: Hands using the control panel of an office multifunction printer
devices.title: Printers
devices.text: Corrective and preventive maintenance for inkjet, laser and multifunction printers. Head cleaning, roller replacement and jam resolution.

devices.alt: Technician opening a phone to repair the screen and board
devices.title: Phones and tablets
devices.text: Screen, battery and charging-port replacement, cameras and board-level repair. Major brands, with original and high-quality parts.

extras.title: Webcams and security cameras
extras.text: Diagnosis, repair and setup of webcams for video conferencing and CCTV/IP cameras. Installation, cabling and remote monitoring for business or home.

extras.title: Corporate preventive maintenance
extras.text: Scheduled plans for companies with multiple devices: visits, cleaning, software updates, component checks and a status report for each unit.

extras.title: No-obligation diagnosis
extras.text: Before any repair we present a full diagnosis and a detailed quote. No surprises or hidden costs. We proceed only with your express authorization.

software.title: Administrative platforms that transform operations.
software.lede: ROSE S.A.S. does more than repair equipment: we transform how companies manage internal operations. Our developers build custom systems and our flagship platform Myshop — Electronic Administrative Service, an integrated system for SMEs to digitize day-to-day management.
software.myshopOutro: Myshop is designed to be intuitive, robust and scalable, growing with your company.
software.customIntro: Bespoke software when a standard system does not cover your needs:
customItems: Detailed analysis of your current processes
A solution designed around your workflow
software.customCta: Request a free Myshop demonstration or a quote for your custom system

steps.text: Build the system and its modules.

software.process: Our process follows a clear, structured methodology. Each phase involves the client, validates progress and ensures the final product exceeds expectations.

products.title: A commercial partner for equipment and accessories.
products.lede: We offer a catalog of high-quality products selected for performance, durability and price. We work with recognized brands and guarantee the authenticity of everything we deliver. The portfolio covers corporate offices and individuals who need reliable devices for work or study. Every product is quality-checked before delivery.

items.title: Computers and towers
items.text: New desktops and custom towers to specification — from basic office PCs to high-performance workstations for design, programming or video editing.

items.title: Laptops
items.text: Lightweight ultrabooks, rugged business notebooks and latest-generation gaming machines. All brands and models available on request.

items.title: Security cameras and webcams
items.text: CCTV and IP systems for home and business, with installation included. High-definition webcams for conferencing, virtual classes and live streams.

items.title: Phones and tablets
items.text: Devices from leading brands across price ranges, with advice to match your needs and budget.

items.title: Audio and video
items.text: Speakers, headphones, microphones and projectors for offices, meeting rooms and commercial spaces. Complete AV solutions.

items.title: Cables, adapters and peripherals
items.text: Network, HDMI and USB cables, adapters, extensions, keyboards, mice, hubs and accessories to keep operations running.

products.note: Ask for our latest full catalog. We offer special pricing for wholesale purchases and companies that need technology provisioning.

why.title: Why choose ROSE S.A.S.?
why.lede: In a market with many options, we stand out through experience, commitment and quality. We are not just a workshop: we are a strategic partner for your company’s technology growth. For more than five years we have prioritized transparency, efficiency and tangible results.
why.lede2: We understand the needs of SMEs and companies in Villavicencio and Meta. From speed on a critical failure to advice on choosing technology, every interaction is designed to add value. An integrated portfolio — repair, maintenance, software development and product sales — gives you a single trusted counterpart and lower coordination costs.

stats.text: Serving companies and individuals in Villavicencio and Meta with technical excellence.
Quality commitment: every job is reviewed and guaranteed before delivery.
Fast response, prioritizing urgent cases to minimize operational impact.
Full service: repair, software and products in one place.

cards.title: Full transparency
cards.text: A clear diagnosis and detailed quote before any work. You decide with complete information.

cards.title: Warranty on every service
cards.text: Repairs and products with a written warranty. If something does not work as it should, we resolve it at no extra cost.

cards.title: Personalized advice
cards.text: We do not sell for the sake of selling. We help you decide based on your budget and goals.

cards.title: Continuous upskilling
cards.text: Our staff trains on the latest technologies, trends and methods in the sector.

team.title: Our people
team.lede: ROSE S.A.S.’s most valuable asset is its people: highly trained professionals across specialties, with certified technical education and proven experience. We update skills continuously and apply a rigorous selection and internal training process before anyone serves a client.
team.techText: Hardware and electronics repair: computers, mobile devices, printers and security systems.
techItems: Minimum three years’ experience per technician
team.devText: Engineers and programmers for administrative systems, web platforms and mobile apps, using agile methods.
devItems: Experience in POS and administrative systems

cards.title: Certified training
cards.text: All staff hold recognized technical certifications and attend periodic update programs.

cards.title: Teamwork
cards.text: We coordinate specialties for projects that require an integrated solution.

cards.title: Customer care
cards.text: Training for a positive experience from first contact through final delivery.

cards.title: Confidentiality
cards.text: Every team member signs confidentiality agreements to protect your company’s information and data.

coverage.title: Presence and coverage in Meta
coverage.lede: ROSE S.A.S. is headquartered in Villavicencio, capital of the Meta department. Our strategic location lets us support regional business growth and serve nearby municipalities. Meta is developing rapidly: we were founded to meet that need and are now a local technology reference, attentive to its challenges and opportunities.
coverage.areaLede: On-site service for companies with device fleets and remote support for software and configuration.
cities: Granada, San Martín and Puerto López
coverage.onsiteText: Technicians travel to the client’s premises for diagnosis, repair and maintenance, avoiding disruption to operations.
coverage.onsiteNote: Ask about availability in your area. In urban Villavicencio there is no extra travel charge for companies with a maintenance contract.
